fixtures.name: zipf

fixtures.name: nullszipf
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT CASE WHEN i%10=0 THEN NULL ELSE 140737488355328+(CASE WHEN i%5<>0 THEN i%13 ELSE CAST(hash(i+17)%100003 AS BIGINT) END) END AS k, CASE WHEN i%19=0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(hash(i+29)%100000 AS BIGINT) END AS x,i AS rid FROM range(1048592) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION SNAPPY, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 65536)
